title.narrative: Youth employment for socio-economic stability in Upper Egypt

description.narrative: The proposed project aims at diversifying the local economy, increasing the resilience of communities and individuals, enhancing the employability of youths integrating them productively into the economy also to avoid phenomena of radicalization or illegal migration. The proposed approach aims at stimulating private sector growth in priority clusters / value chains and thereby improving the productivity and competitiveness of youth-led start-ups and micro and small enterprises in targeted sectors. Simultaneously the proposed approach aims at promoting skills development for underemployed and unemployed youth and women as well as students for enhanced employability and self-employment opportunities. As a result, the project is expected to contribute to revitalize the local economy and to provide the youths in targeted communities with more and better employment and entrepreneurial opportunities, hence improving their livelihoods.
